content.text:
**`mda_open`** is the tool. It takes a `section_id` and returns the exact source lines, re-checked at read time.

If the file changed since indexing, it returns `stale: true` along with the current `section_id`.

Source: `design/mcp.md`, the MCP tools table (`mda_open` row). The project-plan.md §4.3 "Read-time freshness check" node in the graph points the same way.
